attestation.notes: Controls and location indicators implied finished commercial map UX while behaving as prototype chrome.
Locate/Today’s Search operable but location SOT incoherent (user vs search target indistinguishable). Not subscriber-primary until marker semantics + chrome clarity repaired.
Approximate GPS presented with same ‘You are here’ treatment as precise; search target read as second user location. Honesty requires LOCATION_KIND separation.

OWNER REJECTION of prior SUBSCRIBER READY @ d5f1692 (second false positive). Production evidence: dual similar location indicators (user pulse + target dot), CSS scale pulse oscillation under stable GPS, truncated/cramped chrome, unexplained FAB stack, ethics sheet showing map controls through content, map-dominating hierarchy. Generating CDP screenshots ≠ analysis. Gate repaired: screenshot_analysis + dynamic_visual required.

Production visuals would not support asking customers to pay. Feels like functional prototype: unexplained icon stack, dual ambiguous dots, clipped briefing. Commercial visual gate unanswered on prior false pass.

Prior adversarial pass missed static visual + dynamic marker defects. Independent disproof now includes attacks 7–10 (visual theater, missing dynamic, non-production visual, commercial visual unanswered).
